_comment_about_this_file: Claude Code hooks for the ERP backend. Hooks enforce things prose can't reliably catch. The real hook API receives a JSON payload on stdin (containing tool_name, tool_input, file_path, etc.) — parse it with 'jq' or a small script. The shell scripts referenced below live in .claude/hooks/. Verify input shape against the current docs at https://docs.claude.com, or use the interactive '/hooks' command inside Claude Code to configure these through a menu rather than editing JSON by hand.
